claim: How the original FONT.24 draws every traditional-only character (OpenCC TSCharacters key) that the remake text sources use. Read by eye from the glyph bitmaps (4x／3x nearest-neighbour sheets, doubtful glyphs re-read at 3x and as text rows); the OpenCC table only names the candidate forms. FONT.15 was spot-checked (說體後職) and agrees.

職.note: the 職 slot (Big5 C2BE) holds the 翻 glyph and the 翻 slot (C2BD) holds 职: the original prints 職業 as 翻业 and 翻騰 as 职腾 (font bug); the remake shows 职 and keeps 翻

噁.note: 口+恶 (U+2BAC7, CJK Ext-E) is missing from the system UI font; the remake shows 恶

unresolved.鍾: left component 钅 or 金 not resolvable at 24 px (read as 金 at 3x); the remake uses OpenCC 钟
unresolved.針: left component 钅 or 金 not resolvable at 24 px; the remake uses OpenCC 针
unresolved.魘: upper part reads as 广/厂 over 鬼, possibly a 魔-like glyph; the remake uses OpenCC 魇

no_big5_slot.絶: Japanese form of 絕, only in English notes (絶技); not in Big5, so the original has no glyph; the remake maps it to 绝 (OpenCC)
